text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias—AI systems can learn from data that contains unfair prejudices, leading to decisions that discriminate against certain groups. To ensure fairness, developers must carefully examine their training data and algorithms. Privacy is another critical issue, as AI often collects and processes vast amounts of personal information, requiring strict safeguards. Transparency is essential too: people should understand how and why AI makes decisions, especially in areas like hiring or healthcare. Ultimately, responsible AI development means prioritizing ethical values in every step, from design to deployment, so that technology benefits everyone equally.
